;"Repository-local Grue Ecology & Colony Reveal. Release 1256 keeps canonical
  darkness and grue lethality authoritative while turning one optional mine dead
  end into an authored ecology experiment: weak light gives plural evidence, the
  permanent ivory torch forces a signature colony retreat, and no grue becomes an
  ordinary visible combat monster."
replacements.new:
"ZORK1 FIRE SMOKE AND STRUCTURAL CONSEQUENCES GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Fire, Smoke & Structural Consequences. Release 1257 composes
  canonical BURN, real flame sources, real bottled water, mine airflow, and compact
  physical state into one authored Timber Room fire. Smoldering can be stopped,
  open flame produces route-relevant smoke, ignored fire drops an old brace, and
  the permanent aftermath never widens or bricks the canonical coal-mine puzzle."
